sample_size.notes: Right-angled descending: horizontal upper boundary + falling lower boundary (lows descending).

target_calculation.description: Compute formation height (highest high - lowest low at breakout point); project from breakout in breakout direction.

ultimate_high_method.definition: Highest price after upward breakout before 20% reversal

ultimate_low_method.definition: Lowest price after downward breakout before 20% reversal

failure_definition.description: Break-even failure: price fails to move 5% in breakout direction. See Table 7.3 for full curve.

failure_rate.special_ratio_note: Bulkowski notes for UD: bull BE failure is approximately 3x bear BE failure (bull market more resilient to downward breakout).
failure_rate.notes: Full failure-rate curve in Table 7.3 — values not extracted verbatim into this spec; reproducer should query PDF page 75-90.

post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_range_days: TBD (PDF Table 7.4 not yet extracted verbatim)
post_breakout_measurement.lookahead_note: Lookahead inherited from legacy default 252 bars (PDF Table 7.4 not yet extracted verbatim). Reproducer should run pdftotext -f 75 -l 90 for actual days to fill lookahead_range_days.

performance_statistics.notes: More balanced sample distribution than ascending variant. Bear/UD is the strongest mover (23% decline).

notes: PDF source: Encyclopedia of Chart Patterns (2nd ed.), chapter 7, p75-90.
